description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a fragment used in an Android application to display log data via a LogView component. It manages view creation, layout configuration, and text change handling to facilitate logging functionalities within the app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that contains a LogView and manages its display, facilitating logging within the app.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, appearance, padding, and gravity, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Override method that inflates the views, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
